unit_note: USD millions. ...... and (**) omitted not as 0. Ported from the September twin, re-anchored to the October print p34. The FDIC Office of Inspector General line prints no line in October, and Postal Service Off-Budget Other prints (**) in all three columns; both are left out (values in September). FY2027 Month 1: only October, Year-to-Date and Comparable-Period print; c1==c13 on every row and every c14 ties to the September twin's October column. Nine detail lines, all standalone. Both trust-fund labels wrap two printed lines and are one row each.
